goals: Verify the successful creation, updating, and deletion of student (alumno) records via the administrative API.
Verify the API's error handling for invalid operations such as duplicate students, missing required data, and non-existent records.
activities: Send a POST request to '/login' with credentials, verify it returns status 302, and store the authentication cookie
Send a POST request to '/administrativo/alumno' with the authentication cookie and new student data, and verify it returns status 201
Send a POST request to '/administrativo/alumno' with the authentication cookie and existing student data, and verify it returns status 409
Send a POST request to '/administrativo/alumno' with the authentication cookie and missing required data, and verify it returns status 500
Send a POST request to '/administrativo/alumno/update/2000001' with the authentication cookie and updated student data, and verify it returns status 200
Send a GET request to '/administrativo/alumno/delete/2000001' with the authentication cookie to delete an existing student, and verify it returns status 302
Send a GET request to '/administrativo/alumno/delete/999999999' with the authentication cookie to delete a non-existent student, and verify it returns status 500
